notes.title: Trading cards/emotes and good news/bad news
notes.content:
Hello, first the bad news. The owner of this game had a hardware issue and lost all source/assets.


The good news is that he's going to use the experience he gained making this to make a brand new game.

Since it's no longer possible to modify the game, he sold it to me so I can at least provide steam trading cards/emotes/banners/etc to people who bought it. If there's any emote you're interested in seeing on steam, and you bought the game for more than $5, please post a thread with what you'd like to see, along with a screenshot of your steam purchase history of this game on our reddit at https://www.reddit.com/r/phanomgames

Also, if you purchased the game for full price ($10+) please post a thread on our reddit stating that you'd like to get a compensation for it, and I'll make sure you get some free steam keys for this game, as well as the next game that comes along.

Trading cards/emotes/banners should be live around early/mid next week

notes.title: Major Game Rework in Development
notes.content:
*EDIT* See above announcement *EDIT*

Hello everyone, 

The current state of the game is very bad due to our inexperience in game development. 
We had many issues with the build of the game and some issues just couldn't be resolved. 
We've spent the last year learning from our mistakes and we are now developing a rework of the title that will come as a major update to this game. 

Thank you all for your feedback, we promise to bring you a much better experience. 

You can see from the image below how the game will look. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10062473/ad882266531c5fd0c449a3cc71aea41e0ffa24d7.jpg[/img]

PS : you will be able to quit this time. 

Thank you for your understanding.
